description: Source code for the lower physical layer baseband processor in a radio communication system, implementing initialization, start/stop, uplink/downlink processing, and task scheduling.

classes.name: lower_phy_baseband_processor
classes.description: Class implementing baseband processing for the lower physical layer, managing uplink/downlink data flow, timing, and task execution.

methods.name: lower_phy_baseband_processor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the baseband processor with configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts processing with initial timestamps, scheduling uplink and downlink tasks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing processing and waits for tasks to complete.

methods.name: dl_process
methods.description: Handles downlink processing, including throttling, buffer processing, and scheduling next downlink task.

methods.name: ul_process
methods.description: Handles uplink reception, processing, and scheduling next uplink task.
